g.text: DDoS Detection in Software-Defined Networks • Proposed architecture
ONE ISOLATED LINUX SERVER • No physical network equipment • No routing to external networks
Blocked attack packets stop at OVS.
Compatible library / protocol selected in early spike
Client measurements verify real blocking + service recovery
Blue: data / telemetry • Red: attack / mitigation • Purple dashed: experiment measurements
Fallback: ready-made controller if Rust OpenFlow integration fails the Week-3 gate. Packet-In stress & Rust–Ryu comparison are optional.
